$comment: How scripts/import-atlas.mjs files each atlas design. 'variants' groups designs shown as one card with a variant switch (the first member is the card); an id merged into another (a repeat photograph) may be named, and stands for the patch it went into. 'consolidate' replaces atlas designs with supplied drawings and their variants (library/supplied/): each variant becomes a patch of its own, and the atlas ids it lists ('atlas') are absorbed into it, left out of the library with their photographs carried over. Designs listed in 'exclude', or claimed by an organization with an 'exclude' reason, are left out of the library altogether. The rest go into the first collection whose 'medium' list has their medium (else the first collection), and under an organization: Orgs are tried in order and the first whose rules match wins: 'family' and 'label' are regular expressions (case-insensitive) tested against the atlas design's family and label, 'affiliation' is the atlas's own coarse affiliation, matched exactly. Put specific rules before broad ones. A design nothing matches is filed under 'unsorted' and the import says so.

replace.limitations: Constructed flat-colour redraw of the supplied reference image (BC Parks Branch vector package): editable rings, mountain vertices, hand-drafted elk curves and 26 individually placed letter outlines. Not an authenticated government master; the original typeface is unverified, small contour and stroke differences remain, and flat sampled sRGB colours replace the source's shading. See the package README.

The arch, white frame and lettering are the atlas's reconstruction; the landscape inside the window is the supplied BC Parks scene vector package (reference-fit editable scene), fitted to the window by compose.mjs. Neither is an official original or a pixel-identical facsimile; the scene's forest and water are reference-fit regions, not individually drawn trees. Typeface and thread colours are interpreted.

replace.quality: Constructed semicircle with PofBC's flag badge

Inside it is PofBC's BC Parks flag badge (its flag and outlined BC / Parks, as PofBC's generator exports it), in the atlas's thread colours, at the largest size that keeps an even clearance from the field's edge (bc-parks-semicircles/compose.mjs). Thread colours and the patch's exact proportions are interpreted.

The geometry is constructed (bc-parks-semicircles/compose.mjs): a true semicircle, its field the exact inset by the border width, BRITISH COLUMBIA on a concentric arc and PARKS BRANCH on a straight baseline, both an even clearance inside the field. The letter outlines, colours and the span of each line are the atlas reconstruction's, from a photograph: the exact embroidered alphabet and thread colours remain unverified.

replace.quality: Atlas shield with PofBC's BC Hydro symbol
replace.limitations: The shield, gold border and B.C. HYDRO / SECURITY lettering are the atlas's reconstruction from a low-resolution collector board. The centre is BC Hydro's ringed two-star H as PofBC draws it (Logos → BC Hydro, full authority name: the manual's symbol in its scanned green and blue), on a light disc, fitted by compose.mjs in place of the atlas's plain H monogram, after the photograph. Thread colours and the symbol's size on the patch are interpreted.

replace.quality: Atlas shield with PofBC's BC Parks flag
replace.limitations: The border, provincial mark and captions are the atlas's reconstruction; natural outlined replacement fonts approximate the embroidered alphabets. The flag beside BC is the waving flag of PofBC's BC Parks flag badge (Logos → BC Parks), in the patch's cream thread, fitted by compose.mjs in place of the atlas's symbolic flag. Exact stitch anatomy, dimensions and thread colours remain unverified.

replace.quality: Constructed rocker and box, atlas lettering
replace.limitations: The outline is constructed (moosecop-division-flash/compose.mjs): the regular felt flash's curved rocker, as on the Game Commission and Fish & Game flashes, merged with a box under its centre, and the gold inset the same union of their insets. Lettering and colours are the atlas's interpretation; exact font identity, physical dimensions and thread colours are approximate.

replace.quality: Constructed custom lettering and felt shape
replace.limitations: Manual geometric reconstruction from the supplied Game Warden photograph: narrow custom upper capitals individually positioned along the arch, broader closely stacked GAME/WARDEN, and a constructed felt silhouette with an independent gold inset. No raster trace or font dependency. Fabric distortion is regularized; the historical alphabet, physical dimensions and calibrated thread colours are unverified. See supplied/bc-game-warden/README.md.

Reference-based geometric reconstruction of the upper Fish & Game title in the supplied paired photograph (also sighting MC13-O01). Custom Bezier-stroke capitals, independently fitted row curvature and spacing, and a constructed felt outline with bevelled ends. No raster trace or font dependency. The 306 by 172 reference image limits fine detail; exact historic alphabet, physical dimensions and thread colours remain unverified. See supplied/bc-fish-game-rockers/README.md.

replace.quality: Constructed rocker, center tab and custom lettering
replace.limitations: Reference-based geometric reconstruction of the lower Predator Control / Division patch: a wide, shallow connected rocker with a narrower center tab, custom condensed capitals on an independent curved baseline, and almost horizontal DIVISION. Outlined lettering is tagged for raised satin stitching. No raster trace or font dependency. The 306 by 172 paired photograph limits fine detail; exact historic alphabet, dimensions and thread colours remain unverified. See supplied/bc-fish-game-rockers/README.md.

Drawn from PofBC's Forest Service evergreen emblem (Internal Logos → Forests) by compose.mjs: its bowed badge as the outline and an inset copy as the cloth field, its mainland, islands and evergreen, in the atlas's thread colours. The emblem is itself a vector reconstruction from a supplied image; thread colours and the patch's proportions are interpreted, and frayed threads are omitted.

Reconstructed from a supplied 66 × 55 photograph using two concentric circles, a heavier equal-arm cross, taller BRITISH COLUMBIA lettering and a shallower SPCA arc (bc-spca-roundel/compose.mjs). The cloth field is pure white, as confirmed by the user; the photographed colour cast is lighting. The atlas's substitute glyph outlines are re-spaced and placed individually; the photograph is not auto-traced. The tiny source does not establish the original typeface, calibrated navy thread colour, physical dimensions or fine embroidery. Not recovered official artwork.

replace.quality: Supplied badge shape, atlas arms and lettering
replace.limitations: The outline is the supplied scalloped-shield shape study (fire-commissioner-badge/source/): a hand-constructed, mirrored outer silhouette and an independently drawn inset field, from a 165 × 174 photograph, so small corner radii are not resolved. The coat of arms, the three captions and the two thread colours are the atlas's; compose.mjs fits the shape to the atlas's canvas and draws the lower caption slightly smaller to clear the narrower foot. Not recovered official artwork.

Manual vector reconstruction of a supplied image (B.C. Predator Branch vector package): a symmetric border of six Bézier arcs, a hand-drawn wolf's head, and fourteen custom glyphs placed one by one for B.C. GAME DEPARTMENT and PREDATOR BRANCH. Not an official master; the shading is flattened to cream and near-black, and the lettering and border are close to the reference, not measured from an original (95% foreground overlap with it). The 1951 date is the publishing page's description, not verified. See the package README.
